rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when handing in plans, forms, homework, or other material for consideration or approval.

example.english: I submit the form to the clerk for review.
example.traditional: 我交份表格畀職員審核。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaau1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 bei2 zik1 jyun4 sam2 hat6

rows.note: Use this figurative expression when someone gives in or yields to another person, force, or pressure rather than obeying them.

example.english: I had no choice but to submit to the pressure.
example.traditional: 我畀人逼到冇辦法，只好低頭。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 jan4 bik1 dou3 mou5 baan6 faat3 zi2 hou2 dai1 tau4
